blocks.source: 英雄伝説 碧の軌跡
blocks.translation: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure

blocks.source: 空の軌跡３作のキャラクターも登場するため、そちらもプレイしていた方が良い。４作合計で１５０～２００時間程度も掛かるので大変だけど。
blocks.translation: Characters from the three Trails in the Sky games also appear, so it would be best to play those as well. It takes roughly 150–200 hours to complete all four games, though, so that's quite a commitment.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Volume / Story

blocks.source: 舞台は前作に引き続いてクロスベル自治州。イベントをなるべくきちんと見るようにプレイして、クリアまで７０時間以上掛かった。戦闘などがテンポアップしていることを考えると、前作よりもさらに長くなっているはず。
blocks.translation: As in the previous game, the setting is the Crossbell State. I took care to see as many events as possible, and it took me over 70 hours to reach the ending. Considering that the battles and other aspects have a faster pace, it must be even longer than the previous game.

blocks.source: 前作ではイベントにおいては、挨拶程度のボイスしか無かったが、今回は主なイベントではキャラクターのセリフがボイス付きで、きちんと読み上げられる。
blocks.translation: In the previous game, event scenes had little more than voice clips for greetings, but this time, the characters' lines in major events are fully voiced and properly read aloud.

blocks.source: 前作では、一時的にパーティに参加していただけだったワジ、ノエルの２人が新たに特務支援課の仲間に加わる。多くの場面では、前作の４人にこの２人を合わせた６人パーティで物語を進めることになる。
blocks.translation: Wazy and Noel, who only temporarily joined the party in the previous game, now become new members of the Special Support Section. In most situations, the story progresses with a six-member party consisting of the previous game's four members plus these two.

blocks.source: 前作で謎が残っていたキーア、ランディ、ワジなどのキャラクターについては、今作でスポットライトが当てられる。完結編というだけあって、張り巡らした伏線を回収しながら、物語終盤では大きな盛り上がりを見せてくれる。（ただし、空の軌跡から巡らしていた『結社』や『帝国』関連の伏線はまだまだ残っている。というか、さらに積み上げた。）
blocks.translation: Characters such as KeA, Randy, and Wazy, whose stories remained shrouded in mystery in the previous game, are brought into the spotlight here. As the conclusion to the story, it delivers a major climax toward the end while tying up the many plot threads it has laid out. (However, plenty of plot threads related to the Society and the Empire, which were carried over from Trails in the Sky, still remain. In fact, even more have been piled on.)

blocks.source: 個人的にはお使いイベント等、削る所を削って、もっとテンポ良く仕上げていればシナリオは満点でも良かったように思うほど。
blocks.translation: Personally, I felt the scenario could almost have received a perfect score if it had cut back on things like fetch quests and been given a brisker pace.

blocks.source: 空の軌跡の主人公で、零の軌跡でも活躍したエステル＆ヨシュアは前回のエンディングで、クロスベルを去ったため今回の出番は限られている。良くも悪くも過去作品の主人公というのは存在感が大き過ぎるので、零の軌跡とのメリハリを付けるためにも良い選択かと思う。
blocks.translation: Estelle and Joshua, the protagonists of Trails in the Sky who also played major roles in Trails from Zero, left Crossbell at the end of the previous game, so their appearance this time is limited. For better or worse, protagonists from past games have too much presence, so I think this was a good choice for creating a contrast with Trails from Zero.

blocks.source: 続編物であるため、同じマップ・キャラクター・技・敵などが多く登場する。特に前作のメイン４人に関しては技の追加がほとんどないので、そこは欲しかった。実質的には１つの作品が合計１００時間以上に渡って続くようなものなので、飽きが入る可能性も。
blocks.translation: As a sequel, it features many of the same maps, characters, skills, enemies, and so on. In particular, the four main characters from the previous game receive almost no new skills, which I would have liked to see. In practice, it is like one game continuing for over 100 hours in total, so it may start to feel repetitive.

blocks.source: システム・バランス
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance

blocks.source: 基本的なシステムはほぼ零の軌跡と同じ。主な変更点として、マスタークオーツの追加が挙げられる。これを装着することで、キャラクターの能力が大幅に上昇する。戦闘で大きなダメージを叩き出すことが簡単になったので、前作の地味な削り合いと比較すると、テンポが良くなった。
blocks.translation: The basic systems are almost identical to those in Trails from Zero. The main addition is Master Quartz. Equipping it greatly increases a character's abilities. Since it has become easy to deal massive damage in battle, the pace is faster compared with the rather dull battles of attrition in the previous game.

blocks.source: また、強力な範囲攻撃クラフトの数が増加。マスタークオーツによる強化と合わせて、ザコ敵を一気に殲滅することも簡単に。快適で良いのだが、このゲームは使い勝手の良い強力な単体攻撃技が少ないので、範囲攻撃ばかりのワンパターンな戦法を取りがちに。
blocks.translation: The number of powerful area-of-effect Crafts has also increased. Combined with the enhancements from Master Quartz, it is now easy to wipe out groups of weak enemies all at once. This is convenient and welcome, but the game has few powerful, easy-to-use single-target attacks, so you tend to fall into a repetitive strategy relying almost entirely on area attacks.

blocks.source: 楽になったザコ戦と比較して、ボス戦の難易度は上昇している。特に後半のボスは難易度ノーマルでも、味方を全壊させかねない強力な技を放ってくるため、対策を練る必要がある。といっても、対処法は空の軌跡の時代と同じで攻撃を無効にする技に頼るだけだけれど……。
blocks.translation: Compared with the easier battles against weak enemies, boss battles have become more difficult. The later bosses in particular use powerful attacks that can wipe out your entire party even on Normal difficulty, so you need to devise countermeasures. That said, the solution is the same as in the Trails in the Sky era: rely on skills that nullify attacks...

blocks.source: 相変わらず攻略情報無しでは困難なイベントが多数。特に今回の依頼の中には、普通にやっていると発生条件に気付かない物がある。しかも、１つ依頼を取り逃がすと連続する依頼も発生不可能になる仕様。序盤のイベントを取り逃がして、最初からやり直したなんて人も中にはいるのでは？
blocks.translation: As ever, there are many events that are difficult without a walkthrough. In particular, some of this game's requests have activation conditions that you will not notice through normal play. What's more, missing even one request makes it impossible to trigger the subsequent requests in the chain. I imagine some people missed an early event and had to start over from the beginning.

blocks.source: 携帯ゲーム機の作品だけど、色々と気にしなければならないことが多過ぎる。電車の中などで気軽にプレイするには不向きかも。
blocks.translation: It is a handheld game, but there are far too many things you need to keep track of. It may not be well suited to casual play on a train or in similar situations.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: 今回から、アーツや一斉攻撃の演出をSTARTボタンによって、カットすることができるようになったのは大きな向上点（カットしても、暗転演出が入るのが気になるけれど）。それでも、戦闘が全体的にもっさり気味なのは相変わらず。通常攻撃にまで、いちいち溜めのモーションがあったりと、丁寧過ぎる作り込みがアダになっているような……。
blocks.translation: A major improvement this time is that you can skip the animations for Arts and All-Out Attacks with the START button (although it is still bothersome that a fade-to-black effect plays even when you skip them). Even so, battles remain somewhat sluggish overall. The overly meticulous presentation seems to have backfired, with even normal attacks having a charging animation every single time...

blocks.source: メインイベント・サブイベント共に、クロスベル市内・市外を行ったり来たりさせられるのも相変わらず。ただし、動力車が使用できるようになったことにより、市外への移動の手間は多少軽減された。
blocks.translation: As before, both main and side events make you go back and forth between Crossbell City and the surrounding areas. However, being able to use the automobile has somewhat reduced the inconvenience of traveling outside the city.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: ほぼ前作と同じだが、イベントによってはそこそこ演出に力が入っている。戦闘面では仲間の増加によって、コンボクラフト（合体技）の数が豊富になった。
blocks.translation: It is nearly identical to the previous game, though some events feature reasonably elaborate presentation. In battle, the increased number of allies has led to a wealth of Combo Crafts (cooperative attacks).

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 前作と同じ曲の使い回しも多いが、やはりクオリティは高い。ゲーム終盤での因縁ある敵達との対決では、音楽の力によって大きく盛り上がる。さすがは完結編といったところ。
blocks.translation: Although many songs are reused from the previous game, the quality is still high. During the confrontations with fated adversaries near the end of the game, the music greatly heightens the excitement. It certainly feels like a fitting conclusion.

parts.source: 英雄伝説 零の軌跡
から合わせると、５作目に当たる作品。前作、零の軌跡のセーブデータがあれば、引き継ぎも可能。というか、シナリオ上の繋がりが大きいので事実上はプレイ必須。

lines.translation: The sequel to and concluding chapter of [[LINK_1]]The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero[[/LINK_1]]. Counting from [[LINK_2]]Trails in the Sky[[/LINK_2]], it is the fifth title. If you have save data from the previous title, Trails from Zero, you can carry it over. In fact, because of the strong story connections, playing it is effectively required.
